market_question: Will PSG win the 2025–26 Champions League?
reasoning: PSG's 58.5% implied probability is vastly inflated for a pre-season Champions League winner. Without Mbappe, the squad is weaker, and historically no team enters a season with a >30% chance of winning the tournament. A true probability around 20% is generous given the competition from Real Madrid, Man City, and others.
evidence_points: Kylian Mbappe left PSG for Real Madrid in 2024, significantly reducing star power.
Pre-season Champions League winner odds for any single team typically top out at 20–25% implied probability.
PSG's midfield and defensive depth remain unproven against Europe's elite.
